title: eugenia pirataquinensis
intro: Eugenia pirataquinensis, commonly known as Piratininga guava, is a plant species belonging to the Myrtaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Brazil, for its various health benefits. Eugenia pirataquinensis is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions such as wounds, fever, and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Eugenia pirataquinensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
